This '''national electoral calendar for 2018''' lists the national/[[Federation|federal]] elections held in 2018 in all [[List of sovereign states|sovereign states]] and their [[Dependent territory|dependent territories]]. [[By-election]]s are excluded, though national [[referendum]]s are included.{{Elections}}

==January==
*7 January: ''[[Elections in Northern Cyprus|Northern Cyprus]], [[2018 Northern Cypriot parliamentary election|Parliament]]''
*12–13 January: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2018 Czech presidential election|President (1st round)]]
*26–27 January: [[Elections in the Czech Republic|Czech Republic]], [[2018 Czech presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
*28 January: 
**[[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2018 Cypriot presidential election|President (1st round)]]
**[[Elections in Finland|Finland]], [[2018 Finnish presidential election|President]]

==February==
*4 February: 
**[[Elections in Costa Rica|Costa Rica]], [[2018 Costa Rican general election|President (1st round) and Parliament]]
**[[Elections in Cyprus|Cyprus]], [[2018 Cypriot presidential election|President (2nd round)]]
**[[Elections in Ecuador|Ecuador]], [[2018 Ecuadorian referendum and popular consultation|Referendum]]
*11 February: [[Elections in Monaco|Monaco]], [[2018 Monegasque general election|Parliament]]
*23 February: [[Elections in Djibouti|Djibouti]], [[2018 Djiboutian parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*26 February: ''[[Elections in Sint Maarten|Sint Maarten]], [[2018 Sint Maarten general election|Legislature]]''

==March==

**[[Elections in Switzerland|Switzerland]], [[2018 Swiss referendums|Referendums]]

**[[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2018 Colombian parliamentary election|House of Representatives and Senate]]
**[[Elections in Cuba|Cuba]], [[2018 Cuban parliamentary election|Parliament]]
*13 March: [[Elections in Grenada|Grenada]], [[2018 Grenadian general election|Parliament]]
*18 March: [[Elections in Russia|Russia]], [[2018 Russian presidential election|President]]
*21 March: 
**[[Elections in Antigua and Barbuda|Antigua and Barbuda]], [[2018 Antiguan general election|Parliament]]<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.caribbeanlifenews.com/stories/2018/3/2018-03-02-nk-antigua-general-elections-cl.html|title=Antiguans go to the polls on March 21|first=Nelson A.|last=King|website=Caribbean Life News|access-date=16 December 2018|archive-date=16 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216074500/https://www.caribbeanlifenews.com/stories/2018/3/2018-03-02-nk-antigua-general-elections-cl.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

*12 May: 
**[[Elections in East Timor|East Timor]], [[2018 East Timorese parliamentary election|Parliament]]

*13 May: [[Elections in Slovenia|Slovenia]], [[2018 Slovenian railway referendum|Referendum]]

*17 May: [[Elections in Burundi|Burundi]], [[2018 Burundian constitutional referendum|Constitutional Referendum]]

*27 May: [[Elections in Colombia|Colombia]], [[2018 Colombian presidential election|President (1st round)]]
